title: First coordinate of the normalized pair sum
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every pair of sign vectors $x,y$ of length $n$, the first coordinate of their normalized correlated sum is $(\sqrt n)^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$, with signs interpreted as real numbers.
caveat: At $n=0$, the reciprocal square root is interpreted as the real reciprocal of $\sqrt 0$, and the sum is empty.
